note: Industry classification crosswalk table for CENSUS. NACE Rev.2 to NAICS 2022 correspondences for dogfood sectors. Needed for combining EU (NACE) and US/North American (NAICS) data sources without silent mixing. Always use source classification system natively when possible.

crosswalks.sourceName: Manufacture of chemicals and chemical products
crosswalks.notes: NACE C20 includes products covered in NAICS 325 (Chemical Mfg) but NAICS 324 (Petroleum/Coal Products) is split differently. Direct comparison requires care.
Close correspondence. EU NACE C24 ≈ NAICS 331.

crosswalks.sourceName: Electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply
crosswalks.targetName: Electric Power and Natural Gas Distribution
crosswalks.notes: Flexibility aggregators operate mainly in D35.1 (electricity generation/transmission). NAICS 2211 includes utilities and IPPs.
